newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares may rise more but profit takers await.
newsitem.headline: KL shares may rise more but profit takers await.

text.p: Shares may add on to previous gains but profit-taking activities will limit any strong upward ambitions, traders said.

"Small-caps have been running on hot air. We should rebound but there will be more profit taking along the way," said one local dealer. He said the much-talked about Chinese New Year rally may have started but it could quickly fizzle out.

On Monday, the blue-chip focused Kuala Lumpur Composite Index rose 11.14 points to 1,235.69, as Maybank jumped 1.00 ringgit to 27.00. The Second Board index was punctured by afternoon profit taking, falling 7.24 to 605.69.
Gaming and property counter Olympia will resume trading today after a two-week suspension. The company announced on Monday it was buying a piece of prime land for 750 million ringgit.
Malaysian Airlines, whose service standards were reported to have fallen due to staff shortage, said it has identified key areas for immediate action.
On Monday, the Dow posted its ninth record close this year, adding 10.77 to 6843.87.
In early Tuesday trade, Tokyo and Sydney markets were soft. -- Reme Ahmad (603-230 8911)
